arStrings.szText: Purchased from the Altar of Growth and Decay at the Tree of Whispers.

Feed upon the life force of nearby enemies whenever you use a skill with a cooldown, increasing your primary stat by {c_number}[SF_4*100|%|]{/c} per monster for {c_random}[SF_5|1|]{/c} seconds.{if:SF_2} {c_important}Soul Harvest{/c} does not lose duration so long as enemies are nearby.{/if}
